queries.query: Large language model hallucination network configuration generation failures "network configuration" "hallucination"
queries.rationale: Capture documented cases and analyses of hallucination-like errors when LLMs generate network configurations or commands.

queries.query: LLM-generated CLI commands errors "Cisco" "Juniper" "configuration" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Find vendor-CLI-specific failure reports and studies showing syntactic/semantic mismatches on real-world device CLIs.

queries.query: causes of LLM overconfidence calibration "confidence calibration" "language model"
queries.rationale: Mechanistic literature on model calibration and how overconfidence leads to unreliable NetOps outputs.

queries.query: prompt sensitivity and brittleness in LLM task performance "prompt engineering" "sensitivity" "robustness"
queries.rationale: Understand how small prompt differences change NetOps outputs and failure rates.

queries.query: generate-validate-repair architecture for configuration generation "validator" "repair" "LLM" "network"
queries.rationale: Collect prior work on a generate-then-validate pipeline for network configuration and repair workflows.

queries.query: deterministic network configuration verification tools "Batfish" "header space analysis" "miniZinc"
queries.rationale: Locate authoritative deterministic verifiers and formal methods used to check config correctness (use as validators/ground truth).

queries.query: controlled fault injection network configuration experiments "fault injection" "configuration repair"
queries.rationale: Identify methodologies and prior experiments that deterministically inject faults into configs for controlled-challenge evaluation.

queries.query: AIOps and LLMs for operational workflows "AIOps" "LLM" "network operations"
queries.rationale: Survey adjacent AIOps literature where ML assists operational decision-making, monitoring, and remediation.

queries.query: bounded self-correction and verifier-guided prompting "tool use" "verifier-guided" "LLM"
queries.rationale: Find work on guiding LLMs with external tools/verifiers and bounded correction strategies relevant to NetOps repairs.

queries.query: constrained decoding and safe generation techniques for critical systems "constrained decoding" "safe generation"
queries.rationale: Identify decoding and constraint-enforcement methods that can reduce unsafe or invalid config outputs.

queries.query: benchmarks for LLMs on networking tasks "NetOps benchmark" "network configuration benchmark" "6G-Bench" "TSNBench"
queries.rationale: Collect existing benchmarks and datasets used to evaluate LLMs on network-related tasks to critique construct validity.

queries.query: threats to validity benchmarks "construct validity" "benchmark bias" "dataset representativeness"
queries.rationale: Gather methodological literature about benchmark validity, bias, and representativeness applicable to NetOps datasets.

queries.query: metrics for evaluating configuration correctness and safety "configuration correctness metric" "policy compliance" "reachability"
queries.rationale: Find operationally meaningful metrics (reachability, ACL correctness, security violation counts) to evaluate outcomes.

queries.query: paired experimental designs and analysis for intervention studies "paired design" "paired inference" "exact tests"
queries.rationale: Locate statistical methodology for paired experiments, especially exact and small-sample inference relevant to controlled-challenge tests.

queries.query: case studies of harmful over-repair or automation-induced errors in operations "automation error" "over-repair" "operator hazard"
queries.rationale: Document real-world incidents where automated remediation made systems worse—inform failure-mode taxonomy and safety checks.

queries.query: LLM tool-augmented agents and orchestration frameworks for operations "agentic" "tool-augmented" "orchestration"
queries.rationale: Survey agentic frameworks (tool-calling LLM agents, orchestration layers) that coordinate LLMs with validators and execution systems.

queries.query: formal methods and SMT-based repair for configuration synthesis "SMT" "synthesis" "network configuration synthesis"
queries.rationale: Find prior work combining formal synthesis/SMT techniques with configuration repair or generation, useful as baselines or validators.

queries.query: evaluation of LLM latency, cost, and throughput in operational pipelines "latency" "cost" "LLM" "operations"
queries.rationale: Collect studies measuring performance/cost tradeoffs for LLM-based NetOps interventions to assess operational feasibility.

queries.query: dataset generation protocols for synthetic network tasks "synthetic topology" "config generator" "dataset curation"
queries.rationale: Understand how datasets/topologies/configs are synthesized to ensure external validity and to design controlled-challenge pools.

queries.query: nearest related work: LLMs for code repair / program repair parallels "program repair" "LLM" "automated patching"
queries.rationale: Leverage insights from program/patch repair literature as analogues for configuration repair and validator-guided fixes.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop vs fully autonomous remediation comparisons in ops "human-in-the-loop" "automation" "remediation"
queries.rationale: Find empirical comparisons or frameworks evaluating trade-offs between human oversight and autonomous automated repair.

queries.query: reliability engineering and safety frameworks for autonomous operational agents "safety engineering" "operational agents" "verification"
queries.rationale: Locate safety-engineering frameworks and best practices applicable to LLM-driven NetOps agents to inform mitigations.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed papers, reputable conference/workshop papers, and arXiv preprints with verifiable metadata
Works published 2018–2026 (inclusive) to cover transformer-era and recent LLM/agent literature
Publicly available datasets, benchmark descriptions, and tool documentation (Batfish, etc.)
Empirical studies, methodological papers, and formal-methods work directly relevant to NetOps, configuration, validation, or LLM reliability
Case studies or incident reports with primary evidence from operators (NANOG/RIPE/industry reports)
exclusion_criteria: Non-English sources unless an accurate English translation and metadata are available
Unverified blog posts, marketing hype, or opinion pieces without primary empirical or technical content (unless they point to primary sources)
Proprietary internal reports not publicly accessible
Pre-lock development rehearsal artifacts from the provided programme (must not be used as final-study evidence)
Works older than 2018 unless they are seminal and directly cited as foundational (explicit justification required)
date_rationale: 2018–2026 chosen to capture the Transformer/LLM era (post-2017) and recent 2023–2026 developments in LLMs, agentic systems, and NetOps-specific applications while allowing inclusion of foundational pre-2018 formal-methods or verification work only when explicitly justified.
